sections.heading: 1. Dead bug (lying trunk exercise)
lines: ① Lie on your back, knees at 90°, arms up.
② Keep your lower back gently on the floor.
③ Reach opposite arm and leg slowly away.
④ 8 each side, once or twice a day.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…
lines: pain gets worse — stop and get advice.

caption:
Momo practises violin four hours a day, and her shoulders and upper back feel heavy afterwards.

Playing an instrument often means holding one posture for a long time. If the trunk isn't doing its share, the neck and shoulders can end up working harder. Clinical Pilates can help build trunk control and body awareness for long sessions.

Hybi's 1-minute pre-practice: dead bug, slowly, 8 each side, once or twice a day. Stop if pain gets worse or your fingers tingle.

Numb or tingling fingers, pain that lingers after playing, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Chat to our team at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio 🎻
